decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several backpacks, focusing on durability and utility. The Maxpedition (prod_backpacks_038) offered a great low-profile EDC option, but the QT&QY 45L tactical backpack (prod_backpacks_057) stood out significantly for its exceptional value and overwhelmingly positive feedback from over 6,000 users. While the Granite Gear (prod_backpacks_041) was an attractive ultralight brand, the reports of strap failure were concerning for long-term reliability. The QT&QY provides the best balance of capacity, ruggedness, and price for a general-purpose outdoor bag, making it the most convincing purchase in this set.
